bends.note: Reading Road runs east-west from Sycamore to Spring, then turns northeast toward Pendleton and sheet 154
L-shaped: runs north from Reading Road, then turns east to Pendleton

notes: The top street is printed 'E. 13TH (WOODWARD)' and is named East 13th Street (sheet 152 prints the next street north as 'WOODWARD (FRANKLIN)'); 40 ft west of Broadway, printed 50 ft east of Broadway. Spring Street jogs at East 13th: the street north of East 13th (sheet 153 outline) is centred ~2774, the 30 ft Spring south of East 13th ~2857, so two T points. Spring is printed 42' at its Reading Road end. The N-S alley East 13th-12th east of Broadway has only '10'' printed; it is in line with the alley labelled 'ALLEY'/'SCHULTZ' south of 12th, so named Schultz Alley throughout; it ends at the unnamed 10 ft E-W alley at y~3090 (Broadway to Spring; listed under alleys only, as unnamed alleys get no intersection points). The E-W alley between Schultz Alley and Spring at y~1779 is unlabelled but in line with Bodley Alley across Spring (Bodley label is east of Spring), so named Bodley Alley. College Alley is labelled only between 12th and Elliott; the 10 ft alley in line with it runs East 13th to Reading Road. Reading Road is printed '(HUNT) READING RD.' west of Broadway: 80 ft wide at Sycamore (south line ~3725 west of x~1848), but the block SW of Broadway pushes the south line north to ~3575, leaving it 40 ft ('40'' printed) at Broadway; east of Broadway it is 70 ft (centre ~3554). The Broadway crossing point is the average of the west (3507) and east (3554) centrelines. Elliott (printed 'ELLIOTT', 25 ft) runs Sycamore to Broadway; the alley at 3090 east of Broadway is offset ~65 px south of it, so separate T points. Sheet is slightly skewed: Sycamore centre drifts from x~388 at Woodward to ~404 at Reading Road. Bodley Alley continues east of Pendleton as Anna Alley (sheet 154), so Pendleton/Bodley Alley is a cross.
